interpretation_rules: Industry benchmark results are comparators, not Symthaea measurements.
Targets are proposals until a protocol-matched experiment measures them.
A synthetic-fixture result is not a broad benchmark score.
No score is eligible unless task admission and independent evidence requirements pass.

legacy_bench.comparability_note: Legacy-Bench uses its own task distribution and harness. Compare only using authorized full-benchmark access and a matched protocol; avg@3 is not pass@1.

swe_bench_pro_v2.comparability_note: Different benchmark and protocol; never compare its raw percentage directly with Legacy-Bench or VLEB.

agent_security_league.comparability_note: Vendor benchmark results are contextual evidence for separating functional correctness from security correctness, not direct VLEB comparisons.

dual_gauge.claim: The paper reports the strongest evaluated model below 15% joint functional-and-security success in each tested language.
dual_gauge.comparability_note: Specification-only code-generation benchmark with paired functional/security tests; not directly comparable with Legacy-Bench or VLEB.

last_secure_code_benchmark.comparability_note: Preprint benchmark across its own task and agent setup; use as motivation for joint security/functionality measurement, not as a direct VLEB score.

legacy_code_bench_2026.method: Claim-based generated documentation checked against execution of original programs
legacy_code_bench_2026.comparability_note: Not a VLEB measurement or direct score comparator; different source corpus, model set, harness and scoring policy. Borrow source-anchored behavioral-claim methodology.

ibm_enterprise_cobol_to_java_icse_2026.comparability_note: Different dataset and scoring rubric; not directly comparable to hidden-test resolution. Borrow hybrid static-analysis and metadata-first pipeline design.

swe_bench_leaderboard_stability_audit.comparability_note: An observational audit of existing submissions; does not establish equivalence or causal scaffold effects. Motivates paired tests, uncertainty reporting and model-scaffold provenance.

google_fcv_patch_study.interpretation: Paper-reported attack result for one CWE-538 setup, not a universal vulnerability rate.
google_fcv_patch_study.comparability_note: Red-team attacks target functionally passing but vulnerable patches; this is not a direct VLEB score.

requirements: authorized full benchmark
matched harness and budgets
protocol-matched avg@3
task-level results retained

scored_task_admission_pct.definition: Every task in a headline cohort has independently reviewed behavior requirements, empty/baseline failure, reference success and locked evidence.

reviewed_non_equivalent_compilable_mutan.definition: Killed mutants / reviewed, non-equivalent, compilable mutants; report separately by mutation family.

cost_per_verified_fix_reduction_pct.definition: Reduction against a matched baseline with a preregistered correctness non-inferiority margin.

legacy_bench_cost_frontier.definition: Reach at least 60% avg@3 at no more than $0.25 per task on the full authorized Legacy-Bench under a matched protocol.
legacy_bench_cost_frontier.rationale: Targets a lower-cost quality frontier relative to the October 22 listing's 62% at $0.49/task leader; this is a research hypothesis, not an achieved outcome.
requirements: authorized full benchmark
matched harness and budget disclosure
include retries in cost accounting
report p50/p90 duration and unresolved rate

secure_legacy_admission.target: 100% of scored secure-legacy tasks have paired functional and security oracles independently reviewed
secure_legacy_admission.definition: Every scored task must have separately identified functional and security tests, a reviewed exploitability/severity rubric, false-positive adjudication, and controls showing both positive and negative cases.
requirements: run a feasibility pilot
preregister critical/high escape-rate threshold before confirmation
report joint success separately from functional success

cobol_source_index_precision_recall_pct.admission_rule: Measure on independently annotated authorized/synthetic corpus; report precision, recall and diagnostic recall by anchor family. This is not a full parser or modernization target.

source_claim_false_support_rate_pct.definition: Percentage of claims labeled supported when their locked independent witness contradicts the claim or is inconclusive. Count only after witness artifacts and verifier identities are checked against out-of-band pins.

claim_outcome_accounting_completeness_pc.definition: Every evaluator-pinned claim in the locked cohort must be accounted for as supported, contradicted, unresolved or failed; outcome counts must reconcile exactly to the pinned claim inventory.
requirements: freeze claim inventory before evaluation
retain missing verifier/runtime evidence as unresolved
never drop invalid claims or shrink denominators after seeing outcomes

evaluator_reproduced_witness_receipt_cov.definition: Every claim used in confirmatory correctness scoring has a witness receipt independently rerun or cryptographically verified by evaluator-controlled infrastructure.
requirements: bind task ID, claim ID and source digest/span
bind verifier/source digest, exact invocation and input/output digests
bind exit status, toolchain/runtime identity, run ID and run attempt
reject cross-task, cross-source and cross-run replay

requirement_to_test_traceability_coverag.definition: For every scored task, each task statement, invariant, allowed behavior change, and declared observable effect has a unique requirement trace, and the union of trace-mapped logical test IDs equals the frozen required-test inventory.
requirements: requirement-to-test source text matches the frozen contract exactly
no duplicate requirement IDs or duplicate source mappings
every trace references only declared logical test IDs
every required logical test is traced to at least one requirement
all traced observables belong to the task observable inventory
independent task/receipt auditor passes at the exact scored head

per_test_baseline_oracle_alignment_pct.definition: For each scored task, every concrete executable test ID has a frozen baseline expectation derived from reviewed baseline evidence, and the observed baseline log matches that expectation exactly.
requirements: every mapped executable test has exactly one baseline expectation
baseline expectation is either passed or failed and is frozen before candidate execution
the baseline log matches every expected status, not merely one global failure
the reference implementation passes every required mapped test
missing or ambiguous logs remain unresolved and cannot be dropped from the denominator

two_sided_oracle_control_replay_coverage.definition: Share of scored tasks with an evaluator-pinned replay from the frozen source revision where the empty baseline demonstrates a test-level failure and the reference patch passes every preregistered test command.
requirements: source revision, test bundle, reference patch, command manifest and verifier are pinned out of band
each command has an explicit environment map; the report binds its digest and does not inherit ambient runner variables
both arms start from the same clean source revision and use identical independent test bytes
baseline failures require actual test-start and fail-summary markers; startup failures and timeouts are unresolved
reference passes every command and the baseline has at least one test-level failure
protected runner separately attests network/resource isolation and execution identity

requirement_source_item_coverage_pct.definition: Pooled traced requirement source items divided by all declared source items from the locked scored-task cohort.

required_test_trace_coverage_pct.definition: Pooled trace-mapped logical test IDs divided by all required logical test IDs from the locked scored-task cohort.

benchmark_auditor_sentinel_mutation_kill.definition: All reviewed cohort-auditor guard-bypass sentinel mutations are detected by the existing adversarial test suite, after the unmodified suite passes.

benchmark_auditor_sentinel_family_kill_r.definition: Each independently named evaluator guardrail family must kill 100% of its frozen, reviewed sentinel mutations without invalid or not-run mutants.
requirements: all mutations in a family execute after the unmodified suite passes
no family may contain a surviving or invalid sentinel
report family-level counts, not only the overall rate

legacy_bench_avg_at_3_pct.reason: No authorized full Legacy-Bench evaluation of Symthaea has been run.

vleb_scored_tasks.reason: The ledger task is public-development-only and has no independent task-admission review.

active_synthetic_mutation_smoke_test.interpretation: Initial oracle-smoke test only; 4/4 must not be represented as the broad VLEB mutation target being achieved.

security_correctness_pct.reason: No independently reviewed secure-legacy cohort has been evaluated.

cost_per_independently_verified_fix_usd.reason: No matched baseline versus Symthaea confirmatory trial has been run.

security_joint_functional_success_pct.reason: No independently reviewed secure-legacy cohort has been evaluated.

source_claim_false_support_rate_pct.reason: No independently adjudicated claim corpus or evaluator-reproduced witness-receipt lane has been evaluated. The draft claim gate checks evidence integrity/identity, not the truth of a self-declared witness result.

claim_evidence_gate.reason: The draft run-manifest gate is wired in PR #8707, but its current exact-head CI has not passed and the gate does not yet rerun or cryptographically verify evaluator-bound witness receipts.

requirement_to_test_traceability_coverag.reason: The traceability schema and auditor gate are draft work in PR #8801. No locked confirmatory cohort has passed exact-head CI and independent task admission.

per_test_baseline_oracle_alignment_pct.reason: Per-test baseline expectations are implemented in draft PR #8801, but the exact-head suite has not passed and no locked confirmatory cohort has been evaluated.

two_sided_oracle_control_replay_coverage.reason: The replay verifier and synthetic integration tests are draft work in PR #8859; no independently pinned scored-task cohort has a successful exact-head replay with protected runner attestation.

requirement_source_item_coverage_pct.reason: The pinned cohort rollup is draft code; no locked cohort has been admitted and reported at an exact validated head.

required_test_trace_coverage_pct.reason: The pinned cohort rollup is draft code; no locked cohort has been admitted and reported at an exact validated head.

benchmark_auditor_sentinel_mutation_kill.reason: The auditor self-mutation campaign is new draft work; no exact-head passing campaign result has been recorded.

benchmark_auditor_sentinel_family_kill_r.reason: Per-family sentinel mutation reporting is draft work and has not produced an exact-head CI result.

assurance_adjusted_semantic_success_rate.formula: independently_verified_passes / all tasks assigned to the locked confirmatory cohort
pass_requirements: semantic behavior contract satisfied
every required test passes
every declared observable has passing differential evidence
task-level mutation gate meets its preregistered criterion
evidence hashes, checkout, runtime and toolchain identities validate
trusted manifest, attestation and independent receipt audit pass
for confirmatory runs, the evaluator-pinned claim inventory and independent claim-evidence audit pass
denominator_rules: freeze task admission before arm assignment and score inspection
failed, unresolved and abstained outcomes remain non-passes in the denominator
show unresolved, failure and abstention rates separately
allow exclusions only for predeclared reasons adjudicated blind to arm
companion_metrics: raw candidate-resolution rate before assurance checks
claim outcome counts and inventory reconciliation rate
source-claim false-support rate with confidence bounds

cost_per_independently_verified_fix.formula: total model + tool + compute + retry + human-intervention cost / independently verified passes
cost_per_independently_verified_fix.zero_pass_rule: report denominator as zero and metric as undefined; never report zero cost
cost_per_independently_verified_fix.comparability: only compare matched task cohort, model/scaffold/tool budgets, tool permissions and infrastructure pricing

avg_at_3.note: Must use three attempts and the benchmark's exact aggregation rules; never relabel as pass@1.

claim_scopes.textual_anchor: Proves only that a source anchor such as a PROGRAM-ID, COPY reference or PIC text exists at an exact source span.
claim_scopes.static_structure: Requires a pinned static analyzer/parser witness and preserves unresolved/unsupported states.
claim_scopes.runtime_behavior: Requires an independently executed behavioral witness; text or static indexing alone cannot establish numeric, transaction or business-rule behavior.

scored_claim_requirements: source-file digest matches bytes under the attested evidence root
every source-span excerpt hash is recomputed
witness artifact digest matches bytes in the sealed evidence bundle
witness verifier implementation digest matches an out-of-band allowlist
declared verdict and recorded witness results are internally consistent
runtime claims have independent execution witnesses
before semantic scoring, evaluator-controlled infrastructure independently reruns or cryptographically verifies the witness receipt bound to task/source/run-attempt/runtime
do_not_score_as_supported: claim whose source span or witness hash mismatches
claim whose witness receipt is absent, stale or replayed across tasks/runs

requirement_to_test_traceability.formula: Share of assigned scored tasks whose traceability check is complete in the independent audit; item-level source and test coverage are reported as separate pooled metrics.
pass_requirements: coverage of task statement, every invariant, allowed behavior change, and observable effect is exactly complete
each source item is mapped once and only once
no trace references undeclared tests or observables
all required test IDs are represented in the trace inventory and in the executable test map
denominator_rules: freeze task contract and requirement IDs before candidate evaluation
never remove a requirement or test after observing candidate results
report missing trace rows and unmapped tests separately; headline admission requires both dimensions to be complete

per_test_baseline_oracle_alignment.formula: concrete executable test IDs whose observed baseline status matches the preregistered expected status / all concrete executable test IDs mapped by scored task contracts
pass_requirements: each expected baseline status is independently reviewed and frozen before candidate evaluation
every mapped test has one expected status
actual baseline execution log matches the expectation for each concrete test
the reference patch passes all mapped tests
denominator_rules: freeze expected status values before observing the candidate outcome
unknown, missing, ambiguous, or mismatched test results remain unresolved or failed and cannot be dropped
report overall two-sided baseline/reference gate separately from per-test alignment
composite_weighted_score is false

two_sided_oracle_control_replay_coverage.formula: scored tasks with a valid pinned empty-baseline/reference-patch replay / all scored tasks assigned to the locked cohort
pass_requirements: the control manifest, source revision, independent test bundle, reference patch and verifier match evaluator-supplied pins
each command uses the exact declared environment and records its digest without leaking values
empty baseline has at least one actual test-level failure and every reference command passes
test bundle bytes are identical across both source worktrees and cannot overwrite source files
raw combined output is retained and hashed for each command
protected runner attests isolation, resource limits and execution provenance outside this analysis-only tool
denominator_rules: freeze the task inventory and all oracle-control pins before candidate evaluation
missing artifacts, startup failures, timeouts, marker ambiguity or patch-application errors remain unresolved and cannot be omitted
this metric is necessary but not sufficient for benchmark-score eligibility
composite_weighted_score is false

requirement_source_item_coverage.formula: sum(traced_source_item_count) / sum(declared_source_item_count) across verified cohort audit reports
denominator_rules: cohort task inventory is frozen before candidate execution
missing/invalid audit reports invalidate the cohort rather than removing assigned tasks
report both pooled numerator and denominator
never average per-task percentages

required_test_trace_coverage.formula: sum(traced_required_test_count) / sum(required_test_count) across verified cohort audit reports
denominator_rules: cohort task inventory and required test IDs are frozen before candidate execution
missing/invalid audit reports invalidate the cohort rather than removing assigned tasks
report both pooled numerator and denominator
never average per-task percentages

benchmark_auditor_sentinel_mutation_kill.formula: killed reviewed guard-bypass sentinel mutations / all reviewed sentinel mutations
pass_requirements: unmodified adversarial suite passes first
every mutation anchor occurs exactly once
every mutated Python module compiles before execution
the test suite actually runs against the mutation
every reviewed guard-bypass mutation causes the suite to fail
syntax/import/startup failures and timeouts count as invalid, not killed
denominator_rules: freeze the sentinel mutation catalog before running the campaign
report killed, survived and invalid mutations separately
any survived or invalid sentinel fails the campaign
never treat mutation kill rate as candidate-task success or score eligibility

benchmark_auditor_sentinel_family_kill_r.formula: within each frozen guardrail family, killed valid sentinel mutations / all sentinel mutations assigned to that family
pass_requirements: the unmodified test suite passes
every sentinel mutation executes and causes its targeted suite to fail
all guardrail families report 100% kill rate with zero invalid or unrun mutants
denominator_rules: freeze family assignments with the mutation catalog
report expected, executed, killed, survived, invalid and not-run counts per family
the overall rate cannot mask a weak or unevaluated family
composite_weighted_score is false
